import pytest
from billing.subscription import Subscription, renew_subscription, InvalidStateTransitionError


def test_cancelled_subscription_cannot_renew():
    sub = Subscription(id="s1", status="cancelled", term_count=1)
    with pytest.raises(InvalidStateTransitionError):
        renew_subscription(sub)
    assert sub.term_count == 1
explanation: Constructs a cancelled subscription and asserts renew_subscription rejects it with term_count unchanged. No existing test renews a cancelled subscription, which is why narrowing the guard survived.
rationale: pytest.raises(InvalidStateTransitionError) on a cancelled subscription is the assertion that detects the weakened guard.
